When to expand platform coverage

Monthly promotion includes at least 5 AI platforms chosen for the business. Additional coverage is useful when buyers use other platforms or the company enters another market. We first identify the audience and buying situations that the extension will cover, then add the relevant platforms to the engagement.

The extra charge applies to the 6th and each subsequent platform. A particular name does not automatically make it an add-on: ChatGPT, for example, can be part of the agreed base 5. The calculation depends on the full set and how many platforms exceed that base.

Choosing AI platforms for your audience →

Platforms in the GAEO catalog

I successfully bring businesses into the answers of 13 AI platforms and interfaces: ChatGPT, Alice, Yandex with Alice, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, GigaChat, Microsoft Copilot, Grok, Qwen and Claude. The project mix follows a discussion of language, market and objectives.

Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode are listed separately, as are Alice and Yandex with Alice. We use precise names when agreeing the matrix so that it is clear which answer experience is being assessed and which additional scope the price covers.

What the extension includes

The option includes optimization for the selected platform, content and structure work, visibility tasks and result monitoring. It is an extension to the main monthly promotion plan. Responsibilities for producing content and implementing website changes continue to follow the selected base format.

For a newly added platform, we review initial responses to relevant prompts, recommended businesses and sources. These findings guide priorities. Strong visibility on one platform does not replace assessment on another; results are considered separately in the report.

The main GEO promotion plan →The plan with content creation →

Maintaining comparable measurements

After adding a platform, we retain the original sample for comparisons. Results from 6 platforms can be shown together, while changes across the original 5 should still be assessed on that same set. This separates expanded coverage from a change in recommendations within the previous matrix.

Prompt count is separate from platform count. If you also introduce new services or categories, the prompt matrix can be extended in groups of 10. In your enquiry, include the current set, the platform you want to add and the objective for doing so.

FAQ

Questions about this service

Do I pay separately for each of the first 5 platforms?+
The first 5 are included in your main plan. An additional monthly charge applies from the 6th platform in the agreed set.
Can ChatGPT or Alice be included in the base set?+
Yes. The base platforms are chosen for the objective and audience. A separate option in the catalog means it can be added beyond the base, not that the name always incurs an extra charge.
Can I buy this option without monthly promotion?+
In this pricing structure, an additional platform is an extension to a GAEO monthly plan. One-off visibility assessments are available through the audit services.
Does adding a platform also add prompts?+
Platform count and prompt count are separate. Additional questions are available in groups of 10 beyond the base 50 prompts.
